How Ordering Works

✦
01

Add to Bag & Send Enquiry

Pick your pieces, add your name, phone, and delivery address with PIN code, and send the enquiry — no payment is taken at this step.

02

On Instagram DM, the boutique confirms delivery details and payment for your order before anything is charged.

03

Pay by UPI using the UPI ID / QR the boutique shares on Instagram DM, and we ship your order.
